F_122.py.description: F-122: make fe_arm engage idempotent. Adds test_bit(fe_port_armed) check at top of __fman_pcd_fe_arm_engage() (shared core, protects both debugfs and API paths) returning 0 with pr_info when already engaged. Also changes F-107 -EBUSY guard in fman_pcd_fe_engage() to idempotent return 0. Runs before F-125/F-126.

F_125.py.description: F-125: make FE-VM engage transactional. __fman_pcd_fe_arm_engage() returned on kg_port_arm_fe failure with pcd->fe_scaffold_* still set; the next attempt overwrote those fields, orphaning the 304-byte FE_ENTER scaffold (gro 256 + mto 16 + ato 32) permanently. Measured at exactly 304 B per failed engage on .185 and .106, reclaimable only by reboot, and the source of the arena fragmentation that made even single-port engage fail -ENOMEM. Also unwinds a partial 3-way allocation. Reuses the existing fman_pcd_fe_arm_free_scaffold(). Runs after F-118.

F_126.py.description: F-126 DIAGNOSTIC (TEMPORARY): tag every early return in __fman_pcd_fe_arm_engage() with a unique pr_err so the -12 on port 0x10 names its own site. F-125 did not close the 304 B/attempt leak on ISO 0501; dmesg ruled out the scaffold-alloc path and F_097's verify gate, so the failing return is unidentified. DELETE this fixup and its manifest entry when F-125 closes.

F_127.py.description: F-127 DIAGNOSTIC (TEMPORARY): tag every early return in fman_pcd_fe_engage() (the wrapper) with a unique pr_err. On ISO 0530 the genl engage fails with -12 but F-126's tags never fire, proving the -12 comes from the wrapper before __fman_pcd_fe_arm_engage() is called. DELETE when F-125 closes.

F_128.py.description: F-128: F-125(c) — free ehash on LAST port disengage. Changes F_092's teardown guard from fe_vm_chain_built to fe_vm_chain_built && list_empty(&pcd->fe_ports). The shared FE-VM chain is torn down only when the last port disengages, returning 33280 B MURAM (int_buf) + 512 KiB DDR (bucket table). Runs after F-092.

F_129.py.description: F-129: add FE-VM chain teardown to production fman_pcd_fe_disengage(). F_092 inserted teardown into the DEBUGFS handler only; the production YNL/genl path had ZERO teardown. Board-verified 2026-07-27: disengage leaves ehash int_buf refcount=1, 33280 B held. Inserts teardown with list_empty guard after __fman_pcd_fe_arm_disengage() in the production function. Runs after F-128.

F_130.py.description: F-130: grow PCD MURAM arena 64 KiB -> 84 KiB. The ehash int_buf (33280 B) + two per-port pools (~9029 B each) = 51338 B fits by total bytes but fails on placement because the int_buf at offset 0x4c100 fragments the arena. Contiguous MURAM extent 0x4ac00->0x60000 = 86016 B (84 KiB). Must run BEFORE F-092 (VM chain build) so gen_pool is sized before any allocation.
